episode.title: Accidental Politicians

chapters.title: Intro: Absolute power is pretty cool!
Chapter 6: The Pros and Cons of Accidental Politicians

episode.tagline: Politics attracts a particular kind of creature — which is why accidental politicians, who never meant to be in that game, are a curious breed.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay relate the stories of five inspiring accidental politicians — and discuss the pros and cons of their situation!
